claims.assertion: Yazhi first proposed that electromagnetic brain-frequency manipulation could induce animal movements; a later update says the videos were likely fabricated, with no sensor evidence of animal-directed control, though she reports suspected control of human groups.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her later update qualifies the earlier explanation.

claims.assertion: She says birds may be especially susceptible because of magnetic navigation sensors, and that awareness can resist imposed signals, though sufficiently strong signals may overwhelm it.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
